_comment: Music per map (plan area 6, item 2443): every map has its own song (audio/music/<track>.ogg, with stems in audio/music/stems/ for the MusicDirector). An entry is either a track name or {"track": ..., "ambience": ...}. Maps not listed (new ones) play 'default'. Outdoor maps name an ambience loop (audio/ambience/<name>.ogg, items 2569, 2570), played on the Ambience bus at -14 dB.
